prompt.description: Edited prompt template text with {{variable}} placeholders. The {{var}} tokens MUST exactly match the currently-resolved source template's declared variable-name set — any drop/rename/addition is rejected (400). Must NOT contain company-specific data — only {{variables}}.

promptType.description: The forked prompt type now assigned to this feature.

type.description: Which stored prompt to use, e.g. 'cold-email' or 'welcome-email'

variables.description: Variable values to substitute into the prompt template. Any JSON values allowed — strings, arrays, or objects. Caller decides the shape per variable. Objects and arrays are rendered as readable markdown into the prompt; the LLM reads whatever's provided. Multibrand is the default in this platform, so brand-related variables typically receive arrays or objects, not scalars. Per-template input expectations are published via GET /platform-prompts?type=<type> (.variables: Array<{ name, description }>). When values are string-typed, recognised keys may also populate dedicated dashboard columns: leadFirstName, leadLastName, leadTitle, leadCompanyName, leadCompanyIndustry, organizationDomain, clientCompanyName.

model.description: LLM model to generate with (version-free alias). Provider is derived automatically: anthropic → haiku | sonnet | opus; google → flash-lite | flash | flash-pro | pro. Omit to use the default 'pro' (google) — unchanged from before this field existed.

brandIds.description: Brand UUIDs associated with this generation. Falls back to parsed x-brand-id header (CSV) if omitted.

leadId.description: Lead-service correlation ID, unique per campaign

audienceId.description: Audience attribution ID. Falls back to x-audience-id header if omitted.

variables.description: Variable values to substitute into the stored 'expert-quote-pitch' template. ALL of the template's declared variables are REQUIRED and must be non-empty (missing/empty → 400). For the platform template the required set is: `brands` (multibrand — ALWAYS an array of objects; each element MUST include brandName, brandUrl, brandDescription, brandHeadquartersLocation, brandLogoUrl), `expertName`, `expertTitle`, `expertBio`, `expertPhotoUrl`, `expertLinkedIn`, `journalistRequest`, `expertAnswerContext`. Inner JSON shape per variable is caller's choice; the authoritative input list is published via GET /platform-prompts?type=expert-quote-pitch (.variables).

templateType.description: Explicit prompt type to render, overriding feature assignment + platform default. Resolution order: templateType ▸ feature assignment for featureSlug ▸ platform default 'expert-quote-pitch'.

model.description: LLM model to generate with (version-free alias). Provider is derived automatically: anthropic → haiku | sonnet | opus; google → flash-lite | flash | flash-pro | pro. Omit to use the default 'pro' (google) — unchanged from before this field existed.

audienceId.description: Audience attribution ID. Falls back to x-audience-id header if omitted.

get.summary: Get a prompt template by type

post.summary: Create a prompt template (idempotent — no-op if type already exists)

put.summary: Create or version a prompt (auto-increments type name if sourceType exists)
put.description: If the prompt and variables are identical to the existing sourceType, returns the existing prompt as-is (200). If sourceType already exists but content differs, creates a new prompt with an auto-incremented type name (201). E.g. sourceType 'cold-email' → creates 'cold-email-v2'. sourceType 'cold-email-v5' → creates 'cold-email-v6'. If sourceType does not exist, creates the prompt with that type directly (201). The source prompt is never modified.

200.description: Prompt unchanged — returned existing version as-is

get.summary: Get a prompt template by type (no identity headers required)

post.summary: Create a prompt template (idempotent — no-op if type already exists, no identity headers required)
post.description: Used at cold start to register prompt templates. Same pattern as key-service POST /platform-keys.

get.summary: Get the currently-resolved prompt for a feature
get.description: Resolves the prompt rendered when generating for this feature: feature assignment ▸ platform default. isDefault:true when no override exists (resolves to the platform default).

schema.description: Feature slug to resolve the prompt for

parameters.description: Feature slug to resolve the prompt for
parameters.name: featureSlug

put.summary: Fork the resolved prompt and reassign the feature to the fork
put.description: Forks the currently-resolved prompt type for the feature (auto-incremented '<type>-vN'), then assigns the feature to the new fork. The source template is never modified. Returns 400 (naming the offending variable) if the {{var}} tokens in the submitted prompt do not exactly match the source template's declared variable-name set — on 400 nothing is forked or assigned.

200.description: Feature reassigned to the forked prompt

400.description: Invalid request, or submitted variables do not match the source template

404.description: Resolved source prompt type not registered

post.summary: Generate content using a stored prompt template with variable substitution

404.description: Prompt not found for this type

post.summary: Generate a journalist-quote pitch (Featured.com 100-2500 char constraint)
post.description: Renders the stored 'expert-quote-pitch' prompt with brand + request inputs, sends to chat-service for free-text generation, and enforces a 100-2500 character output range. If the first attempt is out of range, retries once with a corrective nudge. Returns 400 ExpertQuotePitchLengthErrorResponse if both attempts are out of range — no truncation that breaks meaning.

200.description: Generated pitch within the configured char range

400.description: Invalid request body or pitch length out of range after retry

get.summary: Cascade example emails for a workflow (brand → org → global)
get.description: Returns up to `limit` content-bearing example emails for a workflow, with a fallback cascade so it (almost) always returns `limit`: (1) the caller's current brand, then (2) the caller's other brands, then (3) any org (examples are public). Each example is tagged with `scope` (which tier it came from) and `brandName` (the source brand's label for org/global tiers; null for own-brand). Brand-tier rows come first, newest-first within each tier. Content-less / failed generations are skipped. Default limit 3.

schema.description: Workflow slug to fetch examples for

parameters.description: Workflow slug to fetch examples for
parameters.name: workflowSlug

schema.description: Caller's current brand UUID — anchors the brand/org cascade tiers

parameters.description: Caller's current brand UUID — anchors the brand/org cascade tiers
parameters.name: brandId

200.description: Up to `limit` example emails, brand-tier first

get.summary: Get aggregated stats with optional grouping
get.description: Filters: campaignId, brandId, orgId, runIds (comma-separated), workflowSlug, featureSlug, workflowDynastySlug, featureDynastySlug. Dynasty slug filters are resolved to versioned slug lists via workflow-service / features-service. Without groupBy returns { stats: { emailsGenerated } }. With groupBy returns { groups: [{ key, stats: { emailsGenerated } }] }. groupBy=workflowDynastySlug/featureDynastySlug aggregates versioned slugs into their dynasty.

schema.description: Filter by workflow dynasty slug (resolved to all versioned slugs)

parameters.name: workflowDynastySlug

post.summary: Compose a split-screen vertical video (9:16) from a quote and webcam recording
post.description: Downloads the source webcam video, generates a styled quote image, and uses FFmpeg to compose a split-screen video at 1080x1920 30fps. Layout 'quote-top' (default): quote top 40% + webcam bottom 60%. Layout 'webcam-top': webcam top 50% + quote bottom 50%. The result is uploaded to Vercel Blob.

400.description: Invalid request or video download failed

post.summary: Get content generation stats grouped by model (internal)
Process a video through Submagic (captions, effects, export)
post.description: Creates a Submagic project, polls until processing completes, triggers export, and polls until the final video URL is available. This is a synchronous endpoint that can take 5-8 minutes to complete.

400.description: Invalid request body or missing identity headers

502.description: Submagic processing failed or key resolution failed

post.summary: Transfer solo-brand rows from one org to another
post.description: Finds all rows where org_id = sourceOrgId and brand_ids contains exactly one element equal to sourceBrandId, then updates org_id to targetOrgId. When targetBrandId is provided, also rewrites brand_ids to the target brand. Skips co-branding rows (multiple brand IDs). Idempotent.

200.description: Transfer complete — returns count of updated rows per table
